newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA GOALKEEPER SIGNS FOR AMERICAN FOOTBALL TEAM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA GOALKEEPER SIGNS FOR AMERICAN FOOTBALL TEAM.

text.p: Barcelona second reserve goalkeeper Mariano Angoy has moved across the city, switched sports and joined American football club Barcelona Dragons.
Angoy, who will play as goalkicker for the Dragons, said he has been supported in his decision by his father-in-law, former Barcelona coach Johan Cruyff.

"I wanted to live in Barcelona and it was a good opportunity to continue here," said Angoy, whose chances of playing regularly disappeared with the arrival at the Nou Camp stadium of Portuguese international 'keeper Vitor Baia.
